name: my-pi-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the my-pi launcher and @spences10/pi-* packages
author: Scott Spence <spences10apps@gmail.com>

scripts.check: pnpm run docs:check && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build:self && vp check && pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run check:self
scripts.test: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build:self && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter "./packages/*" --if-present run test:self
scripts.release: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && pnpm run build && changeset publish
scripts.coverage: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build:self && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter "./packages/*" --if-present run coverage:self
